erasure_information.title: Erasure Knowledge I
erasure_information.description: Disable the Quirk of anyone you can see. Refresh your eyes with eye drops if you strain your eyes.

erasure_information2.title: Erasure Knowledge II
erasure_information2.description: You are unable to Erase Quirks that include permanent changes to the body, though you're able to Erase Quirks that emit something or transform the user.

erasure_information3.title: Erasure Knowledge III
erasure_information3.description: Recommended weapon to use is a Binding Cloth. Wear the Eraserhead outfit for stat bonuses and increased stealth.

erasure.title: Erasure
erasure.description: Erase the Quirk of anyone you stare at.

binding_ensnare.title: Binding Cloth: Ensnare
binding_ensnare.description: Ensnare an enemy in your Binding Cloth. Right-click when an ensnared target is in range to kick them away.

binding_flowrunner.title: Binding Cloth: Flow Runner
binding_flowrunner.description: Swing forwards using your Binding Cloth.

flowrunner_slam_aim.title: Binding Cloth: Flow Runner Slam
flowrunner_slam_aim.description: Use after Binding Cloth: Flow Runner to slam onto the ground, damaging enemies and pulling them in toward you.

binding_serpent.description: Hold to slam your Binding Cloth in front of you, binding enemies.
